notes.title: Version 1.0.23 released
notes.notes:
Fixed bug where the level never ends if the last enemy alive is a bomber, and that bomber escapes.
Fixed bug where the HUD’s “Enemies Detected” count could be incorrect.

notes.title: Version 1.0.22 released
notes.notes: Fixes a bug where the player's fighter can slide backwards after spawning on the carrier, potentially damaging it (or at least scratching up the paint job).
